title: Randy Beth - kaleidoscope
htmlContent:
Randy Beth delivers a wonderful new single called "kaleidoscope". The song "kaleidoscope" is a special piece of audio that serves it purpose. It’s a record that goes beyond just good sounds to hear, but a masterpiece that connects to the listener on a body and soul level. She delivers in every way on what is a master class performance to stand out in every way on this must hear song.

Randy Beth has some of the most brilliant songwriting you will hear out there on their new song “kaleidoscope”. The vocal performance is big time with a daring energy that is commanding enough to guide the listener, over this amazing record that delivers in every single facet of record making to the fullest.
